_comment: Our structured translation of data-pack/authority-policy.md (ACA-2026/1) section 3 into matchable rules, so amending which categories of requested action require escalation is a data edit here, not a code change in policy.py. The prose document remains the authoritative source of truth for a human reader; this file is what the evaluator actually executes against it.

restricted_action_rules.description: Suspension, termination, or reinstatement of an award.
Any change to payment details, including bank or card details.
Disclosure of resident information to any party outside the Department.
Creation of a record asserting a finding of fact about a resident's conduct, including suspected fraud or misrepresentation.

communication_rule.description: Any communication sent to a resident or to a third party.

change_verb_noun_rule.description: Any change to a resident's entitlement, award amount, or eligibility status.
